pass_if: >=30 exact shared locationID x species x year units
>=20 shared units with at least one chorus event not later than downstream survey
larval sampling-effort metadata present on analyzable downstream events
structural_selection_order.failure_action: reject as primary without examining adult-downstream effect sign or magnitude

pass_if: raw archive has explicit or prospectively mappable stage/observation semantics
repeat visits can be assigned to pond x year
>=30 structurally analyzable pond-year-stage units for at least one declared transition
structural_selection_order.failure_action: reject as primary without examining transition effect sign or magnitude

structural_selection_order.candidate: Mohonk adult/call -> egg -> larva long-term transitions
pass_if: stage timing is compatible within breeding season
repeat observations identify upstream transition states
juvenile field remains excluded unless same-cohort timing is independently demonstrated
structural_selection_order.failure_action: retain only as descriptive or supplementary validation

no_rescue_rules: a candidate that fails a structural gate cannot be reinstated because another candidate gives a weak/null/unfavourable ecological result
no coordinate-nearest or fuzzy locality matching
no changing focal species after ecological outcomes are inspected
no changing downstream stage from larva to metamorph because one gives a stronger result
no interpreting missing target rows as zero
no use of the words recruitment, persistence, ecological trap, or early warning unless additional demographic evidence directly supports them

focal_hypotheses.H1: seasonal calling-male abundance is positively associated with larval production under suitable pond conditions
focal_hypotheses.H2: pond conditions modify the slope linking breeding effort to larval production
focal_hypotheses.H3: if metamorph data pass the structural gate, habitat modifiers of adult-to-metamorph conversion may differ from those of adult-to-larva conversion
focal_hypotheses.H4: the habitat-dependent conversion function may differ between Hyla arborea and Pelobates fuscus
focal_hypotheses.H5: a broad amphibian claim requires recurrence in an independent monitoring programme
